figures.alt: White sectional garage door on a modest Florida home with driveway context
figures.caption: A garage door is a large moving assembly. Confirm that the problem is limited to rollers or hinges before disturbing springs, cables, or bottom brackets.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Nylon garage door roller seated in a vertical track beside a metal hinge
figures.caption: Support the door and address one hardware component at a time. Keep clear of the spring and bottom-bracket hardware while the panel is loaded.

figures.alt: Garage door bottom seal, lower roller, track, and slab in close view
figures.caption: If the door remains heavy, crooked, or unsafe after a simple roller or hinge repair, stop before spring or cable work and have the system assessed.
